THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
FANTASY & PERIOD
067
STUDY 120
Lace Blouse over Velvet Corset
Rights check
Source: 25015.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with blonde hair pulled back
into loose strands wears a sheer dark lace high-neck
blouse with long sleeves, layered over a dark velvet
corset with metal grommets and a central lace-up front.
Layered chain necklaces with a round pendant sit at
her throat. Her expression is calm and serious. Soft,
diffused forest light with blurred green foliage and fallen
leaves. Palette of deep violet, forest green, and muted
gold. Dark romantic and earthy, in the style of a moody
forest editorial.
Dark romantic, earthy, soft
WORKING NOTES
- The lace sleeves over the corset are the defining layers.
- Keep the blurred forest for a soft, dreamy depth.
Try this: Keep the blurred forest for soft depth.
